purpose: Define which evidence classes may advance a subject to which admission state, so that a pull request, a ZIP, a file count, an agent existing or an acknowledgement can never be recorded as completed capability.

PROPOSED.meaning: A scope has been written down and attributed. Nothing has been run.

LAUNCHED.meaning: A named runtime was actually dispatched against a stable, resolvable locator. Sending a prompt is not a launch unless the locator is recorded.

OBSERVED.meaning: Output was seen at the recorded locator. Provider 'completed' is a status, not an observation of output.

DURABLE.meaning: The output exists in the canonical store at a named commit and has been read back from the remote by hash.

INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED.meaning: A separately-identified evaluator, not the producer, re-ran the claim and recorded a verdict against criteria fixed before reading the producer's result.

ACCEPTED.meaning: Acceptance is a founder-bound act on top of independent validation. A producer can never self-accept.

admissible_evidence_classes.COMMISSION_DOCUMENT: A committed commission naming function, appointment, authority envelope, runtime binding and return route.
admissible_evidence_classes.PROPOSAL_DOCUMENT: A committed proposal that states scope and does not assert execution.
admissible_evidence_classes.LAUNCH_RECEIPT_WITH_LOCATOR: A committed receipt carrying a stable provider locator (URL or exact provider ID) and a dispatch timestamp.
admissible_evidence_classes.OBSERVED_OUTPUT_WITH_LOCATOR: A committed observation of output at that locator, with the observation time.
admissible_evidence_classes.COMMITTED_ARTIFACT_HASH: A path in the canonical Git store plus its sha256, both resolvable now.
admissible_evidence_classes.REMOTE_READBACK_HASH: A hash re-read from the remote ref after the write, proving the write survived the transport.
admissible_evidence_classes.REPRODUCIBLE_COMMAND: An argv plus an expected exit code that a third party can re-run without provider access.
admissible_evidence_classes.INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION: A verdict recorded by an evaluator identity distinct from the producer identity.
admissible_evidence_classes.FOUNDER_BOUND_ACCEPTANCE: A founder-bound decision record carrying the exact decision text.
admissible_evidence_classes.CLOSED_IMPROVEMENT_CHAIN: A named chain in workstreams/so02/control-plane/state/events.jsonl that runs observation -> defect -> mechanism change -> regression test -> rerun -> verdict -> currentness promotion, with every link citing an artifact. This is the admissible counterpart of the non-admissible LESSON_DOCUMENTED: the same subject matter, distinguished by whether an executable gate actually changed and was re-run.

non_admissible_evidence_classes.PULL_REQUEST_EXISTS: A PR is a proposal for integration. An open PR is not merged work and merged work is not accepted capability.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.BRANCH_EXISTS: A ref is an address, not a result. Lease and canary refs are coordination primitives, not work.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.ZIP_ARCHIVE: An archive is a transport container. Its existence proves packaging, not capability.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.FILE_COUNT: A count of files measures volume, not function.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.AGENT_EXISTS: A registered, running or completed agent is a runtime binding. A runtime never grants standing.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.PROMPT_SENT: Transmission is not admission and admission is not execution.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: A destination saying it received or understood something is not output.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.PROVIDER_COMPLETED: Provider 'completed' is a provider status, never an Obzio lifecycle state.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.RECEIPT_COUNT: A count of receipts measures bookkeeping, not the thing booked.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.DOCUMENT_DESCRIBES_MECHANISM: A mechanism described in a document is not an operating mechanism.
non_admissible_evidence_classes.LESSON_DOCUMENTED: A recorded lesson that changes no executable gate leaves the failure available.

reproducibility_rule.rule: Every evidence entry must name an artifact or a command that a third party can resolve now.

improvement_chain_rule.rule: An entry of class CLOSED_IMPROVEMENT_CHAIN must carry a chain_id that resolves, in the canonical event log, to a chain in state CLOSED_THROUGH_PROMOTION. An unresolvable or still-open chain offered as a closed one is an error, not a weaker piece of evidence.
improvement_chain_rule.why_no_rung_requires_it: Adding CLOSED_IMPROVEMENT_CHAIN to a requires_all_of list would retroactively demote every subject already admitted under this ladder, which is a breaking change disguised as a strengthening. The class is admissible and checkable; whether a rung should ever require it is a separate decision and is not taken here.
improvement_chain_rule.provenance_basis: The LESSON_DOCUMENTED class already in this file names the failure but cannot find an instance of it, because nothing connected an observation to the mechanism that answered it.

differentiation_rule.rule: Two active commissions may not both claim whole-operation authority over an overlapping namespace without a recorded supersession edge or disjoint scope keys.
